parts.official_mark_scheme_text: $x^2+bx+5=x+1\Rightarrow x^2+x(b-1)+4(=0)$. M1. Eliminate $x$ or $y$ with all terms on one side of an equation. $(b^2-4ac=)(b-1)^2-16$. M1. $b$ associated with $-3$ and $+5$ or $b-1$ associated with $\pm4$. A1. $(x-2)^2=0$ or $(x+2)^2=0$, $x=\pm2$, $b-1=\pm4$ (M1A1). Association can be an equality or an inequality. $b\ge5$, $b\le-3$. A1. Total: 4.
